COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CRLR No. 146 of 2026
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Dushyant Mainali, learned counsel for the 
revisionist. 
2. As per office report, there is a delay of 99 days 
in preferring the criminal revision, which has been 
preferred against the order of rejecting the discharge 
application of the revisionist.
3. Revisionist is already on anticipatory bail.
4. Mr. G.S. Sandhu, learned Addl. Advocate 
General with Mr. Himanshu Sain, learned Brief Holder 
for the State accepts notice on behalf of respondent no. 
1.
5. Issue notice to the respondent no. 2.
6. Steps be taken within two weeks. 
7. List in the first week of April, 2026.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 27.02.2026
SKS
